pois.name: Washington Park
pois.description: Washington Park is a 220 acre city park that include a camping area, a boat launch, picnic sites and a paved 2.2-mile loop road.

pois.name: Mount Erie
pois.intro: Mount Erie is a mountain on Fidalgo Island in Skagit County, Washington, United States. It is on public park land owned and managed by the city of Anacortes and is located in the south of the Anacortes Community Forest Lands.

pois.name: W.T. Preston Museum
pois.intro: W. T. Preston is a specialized sternwheeler that operated as a snagboat, removing log jams and natural debris that prevented river navigation on several Puget Sound-area rivers. She is now the centerpiece of the Maritime Heritage Center in Anacortes, Washington.

pois.name: Burrows Island Lighthouse
pois.intro: The Burrows Island Light is a lighthouse on the western tip of Burrows Island, facing Rosario Strait, near Anacortes, in Skagit County, Washington.

pois.name: Maritime Heritage Center
pois.description: Anacortes Maritime Heritage Center. Operates under the auspices of the City of Anacortes Museum.

pois.name: La Merced
pois.description: Remnants of La Merced, four masted schooner.  On record of National Register of Historic Places, U.S. Department of the Interior, National Park Service

pois.name: San Juan Provisions Cafe and Grocery
Saddlebag Island Marine State Park
pois.intro: Saddlebag Island Marine State Park is a public recreation area made up of 24-acre Saddlebag Island, part of the San Juan Islands, in Skagit County, Washington. The island sits in Padilla Bay four miles northeast of Anacortes, Washington.
